exact_multi_exon: same reference sequence, strand, complete ordered intron chain, and strand-aware TSS/TES within the configured end tolerance
exact_single_exon: same reference sequence and strand, with strand-aware TSS/TES within the configured end tolerance; never included in intron-chain metrics
intron_chain: same reference sequence, strand, and complete ordered intron chain, independent of transcript ends
splice_junction: same reference sequence, strand, intron start, and intron end
truth_counting: unique structural models; deterministic one-to-one matching
f1: harmonic mean of precision and recall
empty_truth_policy: precision/recall/F1 are null and status is EMPTY_TRUTH
zero_detection_policy: precision is null, recall is zero for non-empty truth, F1 is null, and status is ZERO_DETECTION
novelty_policy: absence from an annotation is not treated as false without a truth set

downsampling.method: SHA-256 threshold on seed plus read identifier
